_comment: Full example config — copy to config.json and fill in your values
_check_interval_note: How often to ping each address, in seconds. 300 = 5 minutes. Also serves as IPsec keepalive cadence.
_report_interval_note: How often to send a full health summary to Slack, in seconds. 3600 = 1 hour.

sites.name: Northside Radiology
sites._name_note: Human-readable name shown in Slack alerts and reports
sites._addresses_note: List of IPs to ping at this site. Can be the Twingate connector host IP, tunnel endpoint, or any host that should stay reachable.
sites._test_ports_note: Optional. TCP ports to check after a successful ping. 4242=DICOM, 8201-8203=HL7 Mirth channels. Remove this key to skip port checks.
